The mutant (crates/ferrum-state/src/change.rs:918, `b.len < left` -> `<=`) differs only when b is a deletion with b.len == left inside the `a.ins >= 0` arm. Original: break with left = b.len, add_section(len, ..), inserted = a.i, a.forward(a.len - left) leaving a in its section with a.len = left; the next round takes the arm at :888 (b.ins >= 0 and inserted == a.i), whose add_section(sections, 0, -1) returns at once (add_section :789-791), whose inner loop skips the insertion test (inserted == a.i) and moves a by left to its next section, then b.next(). Mutant: left -= b.len -> 0, b.next(), the loop ends, the same add_section(len, ..) and a.forward(a.len) moves a to its next section. Both reach the same a, b, inserted and sections; cm6's `<` (mirrors/cm6/state/src/change.ts:470) is ported as is.
